item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! It's Monday, November 23. Time for the weather! Monday again. Let's start the week well! Today in Shanghai, it will be damp with light drizzle. The high will be 18 degrees, and the low will be 11 degrees. It will feel just right out there. Rain is about 15 percent likely today. There are 31 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Listen out for the rain on the window today. It sounds like tiny drums. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be overcast, with a high of 13 degrees. This week our theme is rain on the window. Watch one drop and follow it down. That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
